lessons.title: Mastery Endurance 1
lessons.description: Longer passages for building stamina, consistency, and real-world typing flow.

exercises.text: Touch typing is a skill that rewards consistent practice. The more you type with correct technique, the more natural it becomes. Speed is the result of accuracy repeated thousands of times.

Touch typing is a skill that rewards consistent practice. The more you type with correct technique, the more natural it becomes. Speed is the result of accuracy repeated thousands of times. Keep practicing every day.

lessons.title: Mastery Endurance 2
lessons.description: Longer passages for building stamina, consistency, and real-world typing flow.

exercises.text: Professional typists maintain good posture, keep their wrists level, and return fingers to the home row after every keystroke. These habits prevent fatigue and support long sessions.

exercises.text: When learning difficult combinations, slow down first. Smooth deliberate movements build muscle memory faster than rushed mistakes. Accuracy creates the foundation for lasting speed.

exercises.text: Modern work requires typing across many contexts: emails, documents, chat messages, code, and data entry. A strong typing foundation makes all of these tasks easier and less tiring.

exercises.text: Endurance comes from relaxed shoulders, steady breathing, and regular short breaks. Pushing through tension often leads to errors and discomfort. Stay loose and focused.
